items.title: Prom King and Queen
items.creator: Hourglass Studios
items.description:
Are you ready for the time of your life? Well then it's time to head to your fancy school dance to show off your cool moves and stylish outfits! Roleplay in these beautiful suits and dresses and show your whole school who will be prom King and Queen! 

- 8 crowned skins!
- By: Hourglass Studios

items.title: One Block GIANT Lucky Block
items.creator: KA Studios
items.description:
Take on the One Block challenge with a twist of GIANT Lucky blocks! Complete the challenge and defeat the ender dragon! Break the block below you and it will be replaced by another one.

Includes:

- Treasures
- Multiplayer and singleplayer
- Survival spawn
- And much more!

- By KA Studios

items.title: School Teens
items.creator: Asiago Bagels
items.description:
Check out these awesome school outfits! Perfect for roleplaying and casual use. Now get going to class, or else you'll be late!

+10 school outfits

items.title: Jailbreak
items.creator: Asiago Bagels
items.description:
The alarms are going crazy! Go on your roleplay or casual adventure, but watch out for the guards! They may catch you.

+1 warden skin
+4 officer skins
+10 prisoner skins

items.title: Creeper Campers
items.creator: Meraki
items.description:
Get ready to gather around the campfire with the Creeper Campers! After a long week of scaring miners and nightly travelers, they've settled down and are preparing TNT on sticks. Just don't let them burn the TNT too much, or the entire camp will go boom!

- 12 creeper camper skins
- by Meraki

items.title: Masked Mobs
items.creator: Rainbow Theory
items.description:
It's important to be safe! But that shouldn't impede having fun! These mobs are out and about to enjoy the day!

- 10 Mob Skins!
- 1 Free Skin!
- By Rainbow Theory Studios and Rio Eyo Studios

items.title: Neon Zombies
items.creator: Rainbow Theory
items.description:
The undead horde is back in town but...they've been upgraded?? Wearing the latest battlesuit of the future, these zombies are ready for any adventurer that dares fight them. Are you ready to join the undying team to claim the city?

- 12 Neon Zombies!
- 1 Free Skin!
- Perfect for any futuristic undead roleplay!
- By Rainbow Theory Studios and Rio Eyo Studios

items.title: Dazzling Parkour
items.creator: Giggle Block Studios
items.description:
Check out Dazzling Parkour! It's a grid-based, colorful-themed action thriller parkour that is easy to play. See if you can beat your pals to the finish line!

* Multiplayer Compatible!
* Grid-Based!
* Great any level of parkour player!

items.title: Sonic Robots
items.creator: The Rage Craft Room
items.description: 15 super cool, super sonic robot skins with amazing rainbow color gradient designs.

items.title: School Mobs
items.creator: Razzleberries
items.description:
Travel back in time to when these mobs were still in school! Were they good students, or troublemakers?

- 8 skins!
- Pick your favorite mob, including Creeper, Enderman, Skeleton, Zombie, and more!

items.title: Mob Crowns
items.creator: Magefall
items.description:
These neon mobs have brand new crowns! With their sleek, futuristic designs and royal powers, they're unstoppable!

- 8 skins!

This set includes:

- Creeper
- Enderman
- Skeleton
- Zombie
- Spider
- Drowned
- Slime
- Pig

items.title: Delicious Food
items.creator: 57Digital
items.description:
Warning: wearing this skin pack will make you look so delicious that you might be mistaken for real food. Pick your top dish and wear it in the best way with the Delicious Food skin pack!

- 10 skins
- By 57Digital

items.title: Cartoon Animals
items.creator: 57Digital
items.description:
If you love the zoo, then we have the skins for you! Pick your favorite animal and become the cartoon of your childhood with the Cartoon Animals skin pack. Who knows, maybe you will fit right in with the farm you built!

- 10 skins
- Animal food not included
- By 57Digital

items.title: Hacker Tools Skyblock
items.creator: Fall Studios
items.description:
You want to play skyblock but the classic weapons and tools are too boring for you? Welcome to Skyblock Hacker Tools!
Efficiency 10? Sharpness 9? Fortune 6? No problem, in this skyblock world you will find the best op tools you ever had!

+Lot of op tools and weapons! 
+By FALL Studios

items.title: Anime Icons
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description: Everyone loves their anime! Some of the best shows have the best characters! Time to show off your love of anime with some of your favorite characters! Be the hero you've always wanted to be!

items.title: Young Rich Teens
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description:
Young, wild, and free! Become the rich teen of your dreams! Feels the good vibes and let the good times roll!

+ 12 unique role-playing skins
+ Modern, luxury attire inspired by influencers!

items.title: Winter Party
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description: Come closer and snuggle up with us next to the fire! A little winter party is here and we gotta get ready for some winter fun! It's the best time of the year to spend with your friends and family! Better to spend that time in style!

items.title: Galactic Knights
items.creator: CubeCraft Games
items.description:
Put on your futuristic space armour, step into your space shuttle and prepare for battle against alien invaders. But don't take on the challenge of the space alone, bring your friends along and defend the galaxy together!

- 8 Galactic knights!
- Free skin: Zenith Prime
- Unique intergalactic designs!

By CubeCraft

items.title: SKYBLOCK+
items.creator: Mythicus
items.description:
Skyblock!
- Build a skyblock air base
- Skyblock gamemode you know and love
* MULTIPLAYER!

items.title: Dream Friends
items.creator: inPixel
items.description:
The dream friends have just joined your favorite server! Quick, grab this pack and join the fun games they are playing! Look at your best with the colorful and stylish outfits that will make your friends jealous of you! Do your favorite things like listening to music, watching anime, and playing skyblock!

- 11 skins
- by inPixel

items.title: Demon Squad
items.creator: inPixel
items.description:
Join the demon squad and dress up in the latest fashion with these skins! Stand out from the crowd and be unique! Release your inner self and rock the world!

- 9 skins
- By inPixel

items.title: Autumn Teens
items.creator: Monster Egg Studios
items.description:
The sun may be gone, but that doesn't mean these skins can't shine in the fall!

* 10 mob skins
* 1 skin free

items.title: Dinosaurs HD
items.creator: Kreatik Studios
items.description:
DINOSAURS, NOW IN HD! Breed and ride the T-Rex, stegosaurus, triceratops and many more in a HUGE custom world! Tamable with crafting recipes. But, be aware of that lava volcano!

+ The ultimate gameplay experience with animated dinos, music, sound & particles
+ 7+ dinosaurs with HD textures
+ 1000x1000 custom terrain
+ Dino fights
+ Survival or creative

By Kreatik Studios

items.title: Nether Hunters
items.creator: Pixel Squared
items.description: Are you ready to face what lies in the Nether? Dress as a hunter and explore the fiery underworld with your friends! Tired of being the hero? There are several spooky horror monsters you can play as too with this brand new HD skin pack! Maybe you like the look of the zombie piglin? Or perhaps you prefer the wither phantom? You decide, and turn a dream into a nightmare!
